prompt: A breathtaking cinematic fantasy scene set deep in the snowy mountains of China. A beautiful adult Chinese woman stands calmly at the center of an ancient snow-covered mountain path as several dark-clothed opponents attack from both sides. She wears an elegant flowing pale-white traditional Chinese-inspired warrior outfit, with realistic layered fabric moving naturally in the freezing mountain wind. Her long dark hair blows gently behind her, her expression calm, focused and fearless. Behind her, an enormous majestic Chinese dragon suddenly emerges through the swirling snowfall and mist, coiling dramatically around the mountain path as it rushes forward to protect her and drive the attackers back. The dragon should feel ancient, powerful and intelligent, with highly detailed icy silver-blue scales, realistic whiskers, horns and piercing eyes. The moment should tell a clear story: the attackers believed the woman was travelling alone, only to discover that the dragon has been silently guarding her. Set the scene among towering mist-covered Chinese mountain peaks, snow-covered pine trees, dramatic rocky cliffs, ancient stone stairs and distant traditional Chinese temples built into the mountainside. Warm amber lantern lights glow softly from the temples in the background. Add restrained neon-fantasy accents rather than full cyberpunk styling: subtle cyan-blue and soft magenta energy flowing around portions of the dragon, faint pink-purple illumination along the woman’s sword, and delicate coloured reflections across the falling snow. Keep most of the environment naturally lit and realistic. Heavy but beautiful snowfall, atmospheric mountain mist, wind-blown snow particles, realistic footprints and snow accumulation, volumetric light, natural atmospheric perspective, detailed skin texture, realistic hair strands, intricate fabric texture, highly detailed dragon scales and physically believable interaction with the environment. Composition: woman dominant in the foreground-center, dragon sweeping dramatically behind and around her, attackers pushed toward the edges of the frame, ancient temple visible in the upper background, mountains creating enormous depth and scale. Camera: cinematic 24mm wide-angle lens, slightly low eye-level perspective, dynamic foreground framing, deep environmental storytelling, realistic depth of field. Lighting: cold overcast winter ambience, soft natural skylight, subtle cyan rim light from the dragon, faint magenta highlights, warm practical lantern glow in the distance, realistic reflections on snow. Mood: mysterious, powerful, elegant, dangerous, ancient

promptZh: 一个令人惊叹的电影级奇幻场景，背景设定在中国深山雪原。一位 美丽的中国成年女性 镇定自若地站在古老雪山小径的中央，两侧有几名身着黑衣的对手正发起攻击。她身穿一套 优雅飘逸的浅白色中国传统风格战士服，逼真的多层织物在凛冽的山风中自然摆动。她乌黑的长发在身后轻轻飘扬，神情冷静、专注且无畏。在她身后，一条 巨大而雄伟的中国龙 突然穿过纷飞的雪花与迷雾现身，它盘旋在山径之上，气势磅礴地向前冲去，保护着她并击退攻击者。这条龙应显得古老、强大且充满灵性，拥有极其细腻的冰银蓝色鳞片、逼真的龙须、龙角和锐利的双眼。这一刻讲述了一个清晰的故事：攻击者本以为女子孤身一人，却发现巨龙一直默默守护着她。场景设定在云雾缭绕的中国高耸山峰之间，周围有积雪覆盖的松树、险峻的岩石峭壁、古老的石阶，以及建在山腰上的传统中式寺庙。背景中，寺庙透出温暖的琥珀色灯光。加入克制的霓虹奇幻元素，而非完全的赛博朋克风格：龙身周围环绕着微妙的青蓝色与柔和的洋红色能量，女子剑身闪烁着淡淡的粉紫色光芒，落雪中映照出精致的色彩。环境大部分保持自然光与写实风格。大雪纷飞，山间雾气弥漫，风卷雪粒，逼真的足迹与积雪，体积光，自然的空气透视，细腻的皮肤纹理，逼真的发丝，复杂的布料质感，高度精细的龙鳞，以及与环境物理交互的真实感。构图：女子位于前景中心，巨龙在身后及周围戏剧性地盘旋，攻击者被推向画面边缘，古寺隐约可见于上方背景，山峦营造出宏大的深度与规模感。摄影：电影级 24mm 广角镜头，略微仰视的平视视角，动态前景构图，深度的环境叙事，真实的景深。光影：寒冷的阴天冬季氛围，柔和的自然天光，来自龙身的微妙青色轮廓光，淡淡的洋红色高光，远处温暖的实用灯笼光，雪地上的真实反射。氛围：神秘、强大、优雅、危险、古老
